thesis: Tactical post-beat continuation long in a cheap, beaten-down quality laggard. CRM beat +23.9% [FUND:earnings_surprise] at 12.4x fwd P/E [FUND:forwardPE fz]; 20/20 call sweeps targeting the $200 call wall (net +58,153 OI) [FLOW:sweeps]/[OI:oi-by-strike] with dealers long gamma and buying dips [STRUCT:gex]/[STRUCT:dex], into the market's most persistent sector inflow (Tech persistence 1.0) [MACRO:sector_flow_persistence] and 7.9% short-covering fuel [SENT:short_float fz semi-monthly]. Capped by $1.05B institutional dark-pool distribution into the pop [DP:block-stratified] on a thin 191->185 floor; debate not disconfirmed (bull 0.65 vs bear 0.55). Small, defined-risk.

fade.trigger: rejection at the $195 call wall without a volume break - trim/avoid chasing

invalidation.macro: Technology sector-flow persistence breaks its multi-session inflow streak [MACRO:sector_flow_persistence]

optional financing leg below the $185 invalidation; complacent skew makes puts cheap so credit is modest - financing only, not a standalone short-vol bet
